'''[[The Shank]]''' was a region of the continent of [[Alanciar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. The [[Alanciari]], [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] natives of the area, said that their continent resembled the [[Limb/Legends|leg]] of a local creature known as a [[muntok]]; the Shank corresponded to the beast's lower leg. The region was to the continent's west, between the plateaus to the east and the [[Six Claws]] to the west.
